result.summary: Found several visual issues: truncated restaurant names, cut-off category chips, and partially clipped content cards that hurt readability and polish.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with no ellipsis or wrapping, so the full name is unreadable in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, shorten with ellipsis, or ensure cards have enough width so full names display.

issues.description: The category filter chips row is cut off on the right (Healthy is partially clipped and further chips are hidden) with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with visible overflow cue, or wrap/resize chips so all options are fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is heavily cropped by the screen edge and tab bar, so most of the image and any title/details below are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure list items have adequate bottom padding above the tab bar and that cards aren't clipped mid-content.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under Fastest near you cards uses inconsistent formatting (e.g. '€0.90 delivery' vs typical '€0.90 delivery' styling) and sits tightly under truncated titles.
issues.suggestion: Standardize secondary text styling and spacing under card titles for clearer hierarchy.

issues.description: Promo banner and food imagery use flat illustration style that can look slightly soft/blurry at edges against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Use higher-resolution assets and consistent corner radii/shadows so cards and banners look sharp.
